instruction: I closed the Task Pane with all the slide layouts and can't find it. Please restore the Task Pane so I can select different slide layouts.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=8, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to restore the Task Pane (layouts panel) in LibreOffice Impress. The setup closes the Task Pane. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for Task/Layout panel elements.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: Task Pane restoration
Getter extracts appropriate state (accessibility tree) for UI element verification
Metric logic correctly searches for Task/Layout panel elements in accessibility tree
Returns binary 1.0/0.0 score appropriate for presence check
No postconfig needed - Task Pane should remain visible after restoration
Data flow is correct: accessibility_tree -> search for panel with Task/Layout in name -> return presence score
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider case-insensitive matching for robustness (e.g., 'if "task" in name.lower() or "layout" in name.lower()') in case LibreOffice uses different casing
Could add more specific checks for the exact panel name if known (e.g., 'Slide Layouts' or 'Task Pane') to avoid false positives
